translations.about.title: Let's work together
translations.about.passion: I am a frontend developer in training at the Developer Akademie. What fascinates me about programming is turning an idea into something people can click, test and use – on every screen size. I build with Angular and TypeScript, connect apps to Supabase and automate workflows with n8n.
translations.about.approach: When I face a problem, I break it into small steps, read the documentation and test each step before I move on. Every bug teaches me something about how the code really works. I like to work in a team, give honest feedback and keep my code clean, so others can build on it.
